# `factory/containers.py`

[As built](../../README.md) › [Execution environment and infrastructure](../../subsystems/execution-environment-and-infrastructure.md) › `containers.py`

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Manages Docker container isolation for running project gates. Builds and runs containers with sealed networks, handles setup persistence through container commits, and provides integration with Docker Compose for full-stack test environments.

1,757 lines, in Execution environment and infrastructure.
